must: Reuse vx colour tokens with dark and light themes
Keep new project screens behind the browser preview flag
Use the authenticated gateway for tenant operations
avoid: New UI dependencies for existing primitives

decisions.choice: Use a compact, searchable specialist library with horizontal category pills, concise landscape cards and one persistent action per card.
decisions.reason: The Buzzy reference made a large catalogue easy to scan; Veyrnox keeps that hierarchy while retaining its own tokens, typography, accessibility and explicit control over generation spend.

decisions.choice: Use a compact dropdown that gives every model a plain-language job summary, input/output badges, availability signal and live credit price.
decisions.reason: The Buzzy reference makes model choice scannable; Veyrnox adds the operational facts people need before spending credits.

decisions.choice: Separate the Studio's Video, Image and Audio entry points before model and price-tier selection, while keeping the chosen model as the source of truth.
decisions.reason: A short mode switch reduces a mixed catalog to the relevant models without introducing separate generation screens or hiding Veyrnox's price-before-submit controls.

decisions.choice: Treat AI Edit as a fourth Studio entry that opens the task-led file tools hub, rather than mixing transform tools into generation model lists.
decisions.reason: People can begin with the job they want to do to an existing file, while the Studio keeps generation modes and pricing easy to understand.

decisions.choice: Place a compact idea-and-specialist composer above the skill catalogue, then carry both selections into a new Chat draft.
decisions.reason: This preserves browseable skill cards while removing the extra step between having an idea and beginning focused help; the price remains visible before the user starts.

decisions.choice: Expose feature-gated Chat personas as My skills and Create skill actions in the Skills library, reusing the existing authenticated manager and storage.
decisions.reason: People gain the personal-library workflow seen in the reference without creating a competing local-only skill format or showing controls when the server capability is disabled.

decisions.choice: Give each template card separate Details and Use template actions, with the direct action restoring its validated prompt, model and aspect in Studio even when session storage is blocked.
decisions.reason: The gallery remains useful for considered browsing while supporting the one-tap template start shown in the reference, without bypassing Veyrnox's visible price and Generate confirmation.

decisions.choice: Put a compact model, capability, required-input, format and live-price summary above each template's full prompt, followed by one full-width Studio action.
decisions.reason: The reference makes model choice understandable at a glance; applying that hierarchy to template details lets people decide before reading a long prompt while preserving price-before-generation.

decisions.choice: Give every model a plain-language hero, best-for cards, a price-first Studio panel, capability facts, exact matching templates and concise FAQs.
decisions.reason: A model page should resolve fit, required inputs and cost before asking someone to enter Studio; every claim is derived from the catalogue, capability metadata or the existing model summary map.

decisions.choice: Keep skill cards dense, then reveal introduction, best fit, three use steps and expected output in a shareable bottom sheet with a single Chat action.
decisions.reason: This brings the reference site's useful skill overview pattern into Veyrnox without duplicating the actual specialist instructions or obscuring the boundary between Chat preparation and paid generation.

decisions.choice: Use one featured guide, structured guide contents, example MCP prompts and native FAQ disclosures rather than promotional urgency patterns.
decisions.reason: The supporting pages become easier to scan and answer common questions while retaining Veyrnox's quieter, evidence-first visual language.

decisions.choice: Use a playful, input-first mobile authentication journey with pastel creation promises, strongly highlighted consent, distinct provider buttons and colourful sign-in/create-account states.
decisions.reason: The selected Mobbin-inspired direction makes every choice feel interactive while clearly connecting authentication to creating from a photo, video, reference or idea.

decisions.choice: Make the native Explore dashboard use the signed-in website's dark editorial shell, featured Oddlings story, compact chat card, aqua selection states and price-forward preset grid.
decisions.reason: The website is the established product surface; matching its hierarchy and visual language makes the mobile app feel like the same studio while keeping native navigation and touch behaviour.

decisions.choice: Structure native Create like the website Studio: source shortcuts, creation goal, free price filtering, live-priced model cards and clear disclosure that the final price appears before Generate.
decisions.reason: The person should understand what they are creating, what can be used as a reference and what it will cost before entering a generation form.
